regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure in China A-shares: Banks (rank 1, durable, crowded) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, also crowded) sit far above everything else, with only 4 of 22 themes above the absolute-trend gate. Critically, gate_helps is FALSE for this market's history — the trend gate did not even reduce drawdown here — and the track record's directional accuracy is 0.377, so I am keeping conviction low across the board and treating this as a descriptive framing rather than edge.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Coal (eligible, mean-revert hurst tag, breadth 0.30) sustains positive breadth for 5 consecutive sessions relative to CSI 300 — that would retire the watch as an early mean-reversion theme to evaluate, rather than a confirmed handoff.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the cleanest eligible, scorable leadership leg: rank 1, allowed by the absolute-trend gate (eligible true), high durability_bar (0.73) and strong breadth (0.889) suggesting cohesion across the theme rather than a single-name squeeze. The crowding flag (z 1.78) is a size-down caution only, not a fade trigger. However, because gate_helps is false on this market's history, the trend discipline itself is unvalidated here, so this is a low-conviction direction only.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z 1.78) and the 10-day return proxy (r10 0.0073) is tiny — leadership may be a low-volatility shelter rather than a real trend, and mean-reverting A-share tape whipsaws the trend gate.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% cumulatively before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Second eligible, scorable theme with strong rank (2) and the second-highest durability among eligible names (0.60). It is not the dominant leader (Banks), so a lean here is not a reflexive chase of the top. Crowding (z 1.59) is a caution, and breadth (0.643) is moderate rather than broad, which caps conviction.
theses.dissent: Crowded at z 1.59 with only moderate breadth — if the theme is driven by a few large CXO names, it can unwind faster than headline scores suggest.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags CSI 300 by 5% cumulatively before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is rank 3 but not eligible (score 0.682 fails the absolute-trend gate), with very low breadth (0.059) indicating leadership is concentrated in a tiny slice of names. The trend gate is the one leg with historical drawdown value; it is failing here, so this theme does not clear the bar for a directional lean.
theses.dissent: AI Compute has a 'trend' hurst tag and the macro backdrop flags ai_tech headlines; a renewed burst of tech interest could lift it, and the gate is known to be unreliable on this mean-reverting market.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS closes above its 20-day high for 3 consecutive sessions before the check-by date
